sloka: ततः च्छिन्न भुजाम् श्रान्ताम् अभ्याशे परिगर्जतीम् ।सौमित्रिः अकरोत् क्रोधात् हृत कर्णाग्र नासिकाम् ॥१-२६-१८॥
transliteration: tataḥ cchinna bhujām śrāntām abhyāśe parigarjatīm ।saumitriḥ akarot krodhāt hṛta karṇāgra nāsikām ॥1-26-18॥

translations.english: When she was tired and roaring in a nearby place with her hands chopped off, Lakshmana cut off her ears and the tip of her nose in indignation.
